---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or an improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Problem you're trying to solve

A clear and concise description of the user-facing problem. What are you
trying to do that the current binding doesn't let you do?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like the binding to do. If you have a sketch of the REST
endpoint, the YAML knob, the new MQTT topic shape, etc. — share it here.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've considered, and why you ruled them out (e.g.
"Doable today by post-processing in Node-RED, but feels like it belongs
on the binding side because…").

## Additional context

Links to Loxone protocol documentation (cite section + page if
relevant), Home Assistant or downstream consumer documentation, prior
art in similar OSS projects, etc.
